name: csv-refund-filter
instructions: Read the file orders.csv. Parse the CSV content to identify the header row and determine the index of the 'status' column. Iterate through all data rows and select only those where the value in the 'status' column is exactly 'refunded'. Construct a new CSV string containing the original header row followed by the selected data rows. Write this new content to a file named refunded.csv. Do not modify the original orders.csv. Do not use external network resources. Ensure the output file ends with a newline. If orders.csv does not exist, report an error. Do not add extra columns or modify existing data values.
